snippet.title: Kritter: Defend Together  - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo:  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2454700/Kritter_Defend_Together_Demo?utm_source=ytate

Kritter is a co-op roguelite action game where you must defend M.Ark (your base) against waves of enemies. Fight solo or with up to four players. Build your base, upgrade your Kritter, explore the surroundings, and unravel the mysteries of the planet where you’ve crash-landed in this frantic, humor-packed action tower defense.  

Linktree: https://linktr.ee/ljfgames
